notes: cics-crucible hex-attributes / hx-extended-cursor (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): extended colour / highlight bytes, a cursor set through a -1 length, a NUM field validated on RECEIVE MAP. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: first-display
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: SEND MAP ERASE with the prompt, RETURN TRANSID

scenarios.name: bad-account
scenarios.why: CHECK-INPUT: ACCTL is not 6: the field is re-sent red, blinking, cursor by -1 in its length

scenarios.name: non-numeric-6
scenarios.why: ACCTL is 6 but ACCTI is not NUMERIC: the second operand of the OR takes the error arm

scenarios.name: good-entry
scenarios.why: a valid account: the OK message is STRINGed, SEND MAP DATAONLY without CURSOR

scenarios.name: pf5-blink
scenarios.why: PF5: BLINK-MISTAKE, X'F1' in the attribute byte next to DFHBLINK in the highlight byte

scenarios.name: recv-invreq-enter
scenarios.why: survivor attack (#7955): injected RECEIVE MAP INVREQ with RESP(WS-RESP) handled, the validation then runs on the untouched LOW-VALUES input

scenarios.name: recv-invmpsz-enter
scenarios.why: survivor attack (#7955): injected RECEIVE MAP INVMPSZ with RESP(WS-RESP) handled, the validation then runs on the untouched LOW-VALUES input

scenarios.name: msg-in
scenarios.why: input on the extended-cursor map that no earlier scenario sends: msg-in

scenarios.name: eibcalen-zero-enter
scenarios.why: #7955: EIBCALEN 0 though the COMMAREA record is passed (X23)

scenarios.name: dto-entry-good
scenarios.why: #7955: the good-entry input through the typed DTO alone

scenarios.name: dto-entry-pf5
scenarios.why: #7955: PF5 through the typed DTO alone

scenarios.name: send-map-invreq-pf5
